flags.text: Operating margin up 1920 bps over 3 years

credibility.line: Only one promise can be checked against reported numbers so far — too few to score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management touts margin improvement; EBITDA% rose from 0.3% (Mar 2024) to 2.2% (Mar 2026).
Claims of near‑breakeven district losses conflict with no evidence of loss reduction.

bull: EBITDA% climbed to 2.2% FY26, indicating operating efficiency gains.
Operating margin up 1920 bps over three years supports margin narrative.
Revenue grew 77.6% YoY in Sep 2026, still strong absolute growth.
bear: ROCE at 2.48% starkly misses the >40% target.
Free cash flow turned negative in Mar 2026 (-1114 cr).
Borrowings surged 7.7x to 5,757 cr, raising leverage concerns.
watch: Quarterly district loss trends for breakeven assessment.
